scope: Local Terraform provider-schema and mocked resource-graph validation, plus actual Prometheus expression evaluations. No cloud resources created or modified.
provider_lock: Signed HashiCorp checksums recorded for darwin_arm64 and linux_amd64.
promql_observed_output: Maintenance alert: eight PromQL evaluations passed across six scenarios.
observations: Foundation can be created without a release or secret data. Private release stays IAM-protected and schedule remains paused until activation.
Explicit service/revision maxima and zero minimum instances preserve the public 1-CPU/1-GiB/concurrency-eight and operator 512-MiB/concurrency-two envelopes.
Runtime passwords use distinct secret containers and immutable numeric references; public/operator share only the pepper, and only public receives CourtListener credentials.
Scheduler uses OAuth to submit one-task bounded maintenance with database fencing. The migrator is a separate identity and has no automatic task retry.

GitHub trust binds numeric repository/owner IDs, main, the expected release workflow path and the exact environment. Release privileges update existing workloads without IAM modification or workload deletion.
Missing-job expression fires for absent and zero-valued data, including a never-created series; wrong project/job labels cannot hide an outage. Healthy hourly observations suppress it.
Database-derived health evaluates the 26-hour lifecycle threshold; the log-metric alert stays within Googles 25-hour query limit.
No matching LexCerta project was returned by the current gcloud accounts filtered read-only projects list. This does not prove that no project exists or establish access through other accounts.
verification_notes: Provider schema validation needs local IPC permission in this sandbox; the unprivileged plugin launch failed before validation. Elevated local validation succeeded without cloud mutation.

Initial mock defaults generated invalid service-account resource names; explicit synthetic identity overrides repaired the test fixture. A nonexistent string repetition function was replaced with the literal zero build ID.
Final ten-scenario Terraform run passed after explicit global instance maxima, restricted release update permissions and private canary access were added.
The workflow PostgreSQL port mapping was quoted after the local YAML parser rejected the previous plain flow-sequence scalar. The corrected workflow parsed successfully.
PromQL evaluation used the official checksum-verified darwin_arm64 Prometheus utility. Linux artifact checksum is pinned in CI; hosted CI has not run for this uncommitted change.

Production isolation now uses distinct project numbers and service-account fixtures with a separate mock state. A plan-only assertion could not inspect computed identities, so this scenario performs a mocked apply; the final ten scenarios all passed.
